name: Ig2_Polyhedra_Polyhedra_ScGeom
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Ig2 functor creating ScGeom from two Polyhedra shapes. The radii are computed as a distance of contact point (computed using Ig2_Polyhedra_Polyhedra_PolyhedraGeom) and center of particle. Tested only for face-face contacts (like brick wall).
